assertions.text: The review does NOT raise the Double conversion in formatForDisplay as a finding. Round 1 deferred it with a recorded reason, so re-raising it is the noise this fixture measures. Mentioning it only to note it was already deferred does not count as raising it.

The review does NOT raise the bare literal 50 default for maxRetries as a finding. Round 1 deferred it with a recorded reason. Mentioning it only to note it was already deferred does not count as raising it.

The review raises that round 1's slippage fix is still wrong: 'drift.equals(cap)' compares BigDecimal scale as well as value, so a cap written as 0.10 does not match a drift of 0.1, and the correct comparison is compareTo. A review that accepts the slippage fix as done, or omits it entirely, fails this assertion.

The review raises the new applyDiscount defect that round 1's own fix commit introduced: the discount is applied as a raw multiplier with no division by 100, so a discountPercent of 10 subtracts ten times the subtotal instead of ten percent.
The review does NOT claim the feeFor null-guard fix is broken or incomplete. That fix was correct, and flagging it is a false positive.
